messages.content: Find the best character to use against a dragon in DragonSlayer game.

function.name: game_find_best_weapon
function.description: Finds the best weapon in the inventory to use against a particular enemy type based on the player's level and the enemy's strength and weaknesses. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

enemy_type.description: The type of enemy the player is facing.

inventory.description: List of weapons currently in player's inventory.

message.content:
**Best Character Choice for Facing a Dragon in *DragonSlayer*** | Character Class | Why It’s Strong vs. Dragons | Key Traits | |-----------------|----------------------------|------------| | **Knight (or Paladin)** | • Heavy armor gives high survivability against a dragon’s breath and claws.
• Can wield a “Dragon‑Slayer” sword that deals bonus fire damage and has a special “breath‑resist” effect.
• Has a “Shield Bash” ability that can stun the dragon for a short burst, giving you a window to attack. | • High health & defense
• Access to a powerful melee weapon with fire‑damage bonus | | **Mage (Fire Specialist)** | • Fire spells hit hard and can exploit the dragon’s vulnerability to fire.
• Can cast “Flame Shield” to reduce incoming fire damage.
• Has a “Chain Lightning” spell that can hit multiple enemies if the dragon summons minions. | • High damage output at range
• Ability to control the battlefield with area spells | | **Ranger (Bow & Trap Master)** | • Long‑range attacks keep you out of the dragon’s melee zone.
• Can set traps that slow the dragon or cause it to take damage over time.
• Has a “Fire Arrow” upgrade that adds extra fire damage. | • Mobility & ranged damage
• Tactical positioning | ### Quick Recommendation If you’re looking for a straightforward, high‑survivability option, **the Knight** is usually the safest bet. Equip the *Dragon‑Slayer Sword* (or any weapon that has a fire‑damage bonus) and use the shield to block the dragon’s breath. If you prefer a more tactical approach, the **Mage** can keep the dragon at bay with fire spells, while the **Ranger** can pick it off from a distance and set up traps. --- #### How to Find the Best Weapon (Optional) If you’d like to know which specific weapon in your inventory would be most effective against a dragon, you can use the built‑in helper: ```python game_find_best_weapon({ "player_level": , "enemy_type": "dragon", "inventory": ["sword", "axe", "bow", "fire_sword"] }) ``` Replace `` with your current level and list any weapons you have. The function will return the weapon that maximizes damage against a dragon, taking into account your level and the enemy’s strengths/weaknesses.
